reviews.name: Daniel R.
reviews.text: Brilliant service from start to finish. My BMW M8 runs better than it ever has. Honest advice, clear pricing and the team know their stuff.

reviews.name: Mark T.
reviews.text: They rebuilt my N47 engine with all the updated parts. No more rattling chains. Smooth process and great communication.

reviews.name: Ryan P.
reviews.text: Top lads, top job. Picked up and dropped off, engine rebuilt to an extremely high standard. 100% recommend.

reviews.name: Steve B.
reviews.text: Saved me thousands compared to a BMW dealer quote. Fantastic workmanship and my 325d is running perfectly.

reviews.name: Tom H.
reviews.text: From quote to collection couldn't fault them. Engine looks brand new inside. Warranty gives great peace of mind.

reviews.name: James K.
reviews.text: Professional, reliable and fairly priced. Timing chain issue sorted properly and kept me updated throughout.
